faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions? We have answers. If you don't see what you're looking for, reach out to our team.
faq.q1: What types of processes can you automate?
faq.a1: We automate a wide range of business processes including data entry, email workflows, CRM updates, invoice processing, employee onboarding, report generation, and cross-platform integrations. If it's repetitive and rule-based, we can likely automate it.
faq.q2: How long does a typical implementation take?
faq.a2: Most projects go from discovery to launch in 2-6 weeks depending on complexity. Simple automations can be live within days, while comprehensive BI solutions may take 4-8 weeks.
faq.q3: Do you integrate with our existing tools?
faq.a3: Yes. We work with all major platforms including Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zapier, Make, custom APIs, and hundreds more.
faq.a4: Every plan includes ongoing monitoring and support. We proactively identify issues, optimize performance, and scale your solutions as your business grows.
faq.q5: Can I see a demo before committing?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We offer a free consultation and demo. We'll assess your needs and show you exactly what we can build, with no obligation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Automatika's privacy policy. Learn how we handle your personal data.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
paragraphs: Automatika (hereinafter "we" or "the Company"), located in Rosario, Province of Santa Fe, Argentine Republic, is the data controller for personal data collected through the website automatika.studio.
Contact: WhatsApp +54 341 644 6621.

sections.heading: 2. Data We Collect
paragraphs: Our website is designed to minimize personal data collection. We currently do not collect data through registration forms, login, or newsletter subscriptions.

Geolocation: Our demo events page may request your location through your browser. This information is used exclusively on the client side to center the map and is never stored, transmitted, or sent to our servers.

WhatsApp: When you click our contact links, you will be redirected to WhatsApp, a platform operated by Meta Platforms, Inc. Communication through WhatsApp is subject to their own terms and privacy policy.

sections.heading: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: Consent: Geolocation is only activated with your explicit authorization through your browser.
Legitimate interest: Basic operation and security of the website.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We do not use analytics, advertising, or marketing cookies. For more details, see our Cookie Policy.
Our hosting provider (Vercel) may set technical cookies necessary for the operation of the site. Next.js may set a NEXT_LOCALE cookie to remember your language preference.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Vercel Inc.: Website hosting. Servers located in the United States. Subject to their privacy policy.
OpenStreetMap: Tile provider for the events map in the demo section.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We do not store personal data from website visitors. Geolocation is processed exclusively in your browser and is not saved on any server.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights (Argentine Law 25,326)
paragraphs: Under the Argentine Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326, you have the right to:

Access: Request information about your personal data in our databases. Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data. Deletion: Request the removal of your personal data. Blocking: Request the blocking of your data in certain circumstances.
The Agency for Access to Public Information (AAIP) is the supervisory authority for Law 25,326. You can contact them at www.argentina.gob.ar/aaip.

sections.heading: 8. Rights for European Union Visitors (GDPR)
paragraphs: If you access our site from the European Union, you also have the right to: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection to processing.

sections.heading: 9. International Transfers
paragraphs: Our website is hosted on Vercel servers in the United States. When accessing the site, certain technical data (such as your IP address) may be processed in that jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: Our site is not directed at children and we do not intentionally collect data from minors.

sections.heading: 11. Changes
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this policy. Changes will be posted on this page with the last updated date.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.metaDescription: Automatika's cookie policy. Information about how we use cookies on our site.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device. They are used to improve the user experience and site functionality.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies We Use
paragraphs: Automatika minimizes cookie usage. We do not use analytics, advertising, marketing, or third-party tracking cookies.

Technical/necessary cookies: Our hosting provider (Vercel) may set technical cookies necessary for site delivery and security (e.g., __vercel_* cookies). Next.js may set a NEXT_LOCALE cookie to remember your language preference.
Consent preference: We store your cookie decision in your browser's local storage (localStorage) so we don't show the cookie notice again.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Cookies
paragraphs: We currently do not integrate analytics or advertising services that set third-party cookies. If we add such services in the future, we will update this policy and request your prior consent.

sections.heading: 4. How to Manage Cookies
paragraphs: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.
Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies. Firefox: Settings > Privacy & Security. Safari: Preferences > Privacy. Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions.

sections.heading: 5. Changes
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this cookie policy. Changes will be posted on this page with the last updated date.
